body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). Overall Target Completion Date: 08/01/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Research methodologies for prospective and alternative payments, including looking at states which have implemented (ie. body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: •The Lead Agency's market rate survey was not developed and conducted within two years of the date of submission of the CCDF Plan, as required by 98.45(c)(1). (Plan Question 4.2.1ai) • The Lead Agency’s payment rates for infants in center-based care, infants in family child care homes, preschoolers in center-based care, and preschoolers in family child care homes are not sufficient to ensure equal access, as required by 98.45(a). body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency has not established a standard for the appropriate disposal of biocontaminants for licensed centers and licensed family child care providers, as required by 98.41(a)(1)(viii). body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency has not established a standard for pediatric first aid for all staff for licensed centers, licensed family child care providers, license-exempt centers, license- exempt family child care providers, license-exempt in-home providers, and out-of-school programs, as required by 98.41(a)(1)(x). (Plan Questions 5.3.10ai, 5.3.10aii, 5.3.10aiv, 5.3.10av, 5.3.10avi, and 5.3.10avii) • The Lead Agency does not require pre-service or orientation training on pediatric first aid for licensed centers, licensed family child care providers, license-exempt centers, license-exempt family child care providers, and license-exempt in-home providers, as required by 98.44(b)(1)(i). (Plan Question 5.4.1j) • The Lead Agency does not require an annual unannounced inspection for licensed centers or licensed family child care providers, or an annual inspection for license- exempt centers or license-exempt family child care providers for compliance with a standard for pediatric first aid and with related pre-service or orientation training requirements, as required by 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B) and 98.42(b)(2)(ii). (Plan Questions 5.5.1aii, 5.5.1bii, 5.5.2ai, and 5.5.2bi) Overall Target Completion Date: 05/30/2025 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Revise Child Care Licensing Rules to include pediatric first aid. 03/31/2025 2 Revise Child Care Purchase of Services Rules to include pediatric first aid. 02/28/2025 3 Align Child Care Licensing Rules with Child Care Licensing policy and forms. 03/31/2025 4 Align Child Care Purchase of Service Rules with Child Care Subsidy Program policy and forms. 02/28/2025 5 Update State Plan to include pediatric first aid. 05/30/2025

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not require and conduct interstate criminal history background checks for all staff members (or prospective staff members) who resided in other state(s) in the past 5 years, as required by 98.43(b)(3)(i)(B), 98.42(b)(2)(i)(B), and 98.43(a).
